## Data Model Signals

### Entities
- **Person/Contact:** Core entity. Has: Name, First Name, Last Name, Phone, Email, Address, Stage, Source, Tags, Price (budget), Agent (assigned), Created date, Updated date, Last Activity date, Last Communication date, Last Visit date, Pages Viewed (count), Properties Viewed (count), Properties Saved (count), Calls Made (count), Inactive (date/flag), My Next Task (date), Timeframe
- **Smart List / Collection:** Has: id (integer, from URL), name, description, emoji/icon, category (PIPELINE or SMART LISTS), filter criteria array, contact count, cadence/reminder interval (14 days for Warm/Bi-Weekly), requires-manual-contact flag
- **Pipeline Collection:** A named group that contains ordered Smart Lists (Active & Pending Clients, Hot/Weekly, Warm/Bi-Weekly, Past Clients/Sphere: Quarterly, New Leads: No Call Attempt, Cold/Bi-Monthly, Old Leads: No Call Attempt)
- **Neighborhood Collection:** A group with 12K contacts, collapsed
- **Agent:** Assigned broker/agent per contact; shown as a column in the table
- **Filter:** Has field, operator, value(s); multiple filters can be AND-combined; saved with the Smart List

### Enum Values Revealed
- **Stage field options** (implied by filter picker): Stage is a structured enum field; "warm stage(s)" mentioned in description implies stages include at least: Warm, Hot, Cold, Active, Pending, Past Client, New Lead, Old Lead
- **Source field:** Appears as a filterable/displayable field; implies enum or text values
- **Pipeline categories:** "PIPELINE" is a distinct category type for collections (vs plain "SMART LISTS")
- **Smart List names reveal lead classification:** Hot/Weekly (contacted weekly), Warm/Bi-Weekly (every 14 days), Cold/Bi-Monthly (every ~2 months), Old Leads: No Call Attempt (never contacted), New Leads: No Call Attempt (recent, never contacted), TCPA Litigators — Hard Stop (compliance block)

### Relationships
- A **Person** belongs to zero or one **Stage**
- A **Person** has one **Agent** (assigned)
- A **Smart List** has many **Persons** (dynamically computed via filters)
- A **Smart List** belongs to one **Collection** (Pipeline, Neighborhoods, or SMART LISTS)
- A **Smart List** has many **Filters** (up to at least 5, as shown)
- A **Person** has many **Tags**
- A **Person** has a **Last Communication** timestamp (most recent call/text/email)
- A **Person** has a **Last Activity** timestamp
- A **Person** has a **Last Visit** timestamp (website visit tracking)
- A **Person** has integer counters: Pages Viewed, Properties Viewed, Properties Saved, Calls Made

### Non-Obvious Logic

1. **Smart List vs Collection vs Pipeline:** Three distinct concepts. A "Collection" is a named folder grouping (Pipeline, Neighborhoods). Within a Collection, individual "Smart Lists" can be tagged as PIPELINE type (shown via the "PIPELINE" badge). Free-standing "SMART LISTS" in the sidebar section are not inside a named collection. All three render as left-rail row items but with different visual treatments.

2. **Count formatting:** The app uses abbreviated counts: 7K (7,000+), 12K (12,000+), 17K (17,000+), 1K (1,000+) for large numbers; exact counts for small numbers (3, 8, 18, 44, etc.). Implement: `count >= 1000 ? Math.round(count/1000) + 'K' : count`.
